HVAC Assessment

Replace Before Winter 48/100
CURRENT SYSTEM
Lennox XC16 · Gas Forced Air
INSTALLED 1998 · AGE 28 YEARS
Past Service Life

Standard service life for a residential gas furnace is 15–20 years. At 28 years, this system is operating on borrowed time. Efficiency has dropped significantly — you're paying more in gas to heat the same space.

REPLACEMENT OPTIONS
Standard Replacement
Recommended

96% AFUE gas furnace + new AC unit + thermostat. Licensed HVAC contractor, full permitting.

$9,800 – $13,500
Heat Pump System (Premium)

High-efficiency cold-climate heat pump. Higher upfront, lower operating cost. May qualify for federal tax credits.

$16,000 – $24,000

HOME CLARITY AI

Ask Anything About Your Home

Your AI knows your property, your report, your projects, and your budget. It's available 24/7 and answers in plain language.

What would it cost to replace my windows?
HC
Based on your Hover scan, you have 26 windows across 3,240 sq ft. At Hudson-area pricing, full replacement runs $18,000–$32,000 for quality double-hung vinyl, or $32,000–$54,000 for fiberglass. I'd recommend doing this in Phase 3 of your roadmap — after HVAC and kitchen are addressed.
Which windows should I prioritize?
HC
The north and west-facing windows show the most thermal loss in your iGuide thermal scan. I'd start with those 8 windows before doing the full replacement — that's roughly $5,500–$9,000 and gets you 60% of the efficiency gain.
